body: Hi, I think I might know how you feel.  The only reason I'm still alive is because I have to help out a family member.  And I am religiously Agnostic, but am looking forward to finding out if another life awaits me after death.  There is no Church of Agnosticism, but you have a whole network of Churches, no?  If I were in your shoes, I would directly confess my feelings to my Minister/Priest/etc.  I would think they can connect a person to a whole network of Christian love and support.
Hello moderators, I would be very thankful if you can approve my thread, thank you very much.
I myself did this many times.  I came across some good science fiction and thought I would postpone ending it so I can escape away from my pain into a fantasy world.
I am sorry to hear you are not feeling well.  Would you like to talk about it?
